note: Hebrew tsammatekh is the veil (cf. Song 4:1); removing it is the humiliation of a lady made a slave-girl.

kjv: thou (Babylon) shalt not know from whence it riseth
mine: which you (Babylon) will not know how to charm away
note: Hebrew shachrah is best taken as "its charming/spell" (shachar II, cf. Akkadian), parallel to "atone for it"; the KJV read shachar "dawn".
